title: Regular Mason Jars 16oz Glass Canning Jars with Airtight Lids for Preserving, Jam, Honey, Jelly, Wedding Favors, Sauces, Meal Prep, Overnight Oats, Salad, Yogurt (2 Pack)
description:
About this item
🍯【Versatile Mason Jars】These 16oz/473ml glass canning jars are wonderful for preserving, jam, honey, jelly, wedding favors, sauces, meal prep, overnight oats, salad, yogurt, and more
🍒【Airtight Seal】The lids on these mason jars provide a tight seal, ensuring your food stays fresh and prevents any leaks or spills. The round mouth design makes it easy to fill and clean these mason jars, allowing for hassle-free food storage and meal preparation
🍇【High-Quality Glass】Made from durable glass, these mason jars are built to last and can withstand high temperatures during the canning process.Avoid using in high temperature environments with sudden cooling and sudden heating to prevent product breakage.(please control the instantaneous temperature difference within 80 °)
⚠【Mason bottle maintenance precautions】 1. The lid is made of tinplate material, please dry it in time when encountering water to avoid rusting. 2. Do not use excessive force to clean the inner wall of the glass. If it cannot be cleaned to the bottom, it is recommended to use a long handled brush for cleaning. 3. Do not approach a fire source or high temperature environment to avoid deformation of the bottle cap.4.Mason bottles can be placed in the dishwasher for cleaning or used in the microwave, but please note that the lid cannot be placed inside
💬【The best after-sales service】Our Mason bottles have good quality, but some glass products are inevitably damaged during transportation. If you are not satisfied with the received products or encounter problems during use, you can contact us first, and we will provide you with a satisfactory response and solution

reviews_5s: Nice product. Enjoy using this item very much. Thank you!Good quality Ball jars with tin one-piece lids (although they look plain on Amazon). Thickness of glass is good as per usual Ball jars. Handwashing is recommended for lids with immediate drying, so that’s a bummer. Haha. 16 oz is a good size for drinking out of or for storing other things. Good for canning, also, although I haven’t tried them out for that yet.I needed some smaller glass jars for my baking soda and home made hot chocolate mix. These are perfect size. They don't take up too much space so they fit nicely in my shelf. They are not just plain jar, they are Ball brand! pack of 2 with good value.Nice mason jars, I needed some more and these work perfectly, exactly what they say they are!You can’t tell from the listing, but these appear to be genuine “Ball” brand Mason jars. I just needed more glass jars to store my juices and dressings, and I do prefer the Ball brand. So I was pleasantly surprised to open my package and see the Ball logo and design. It’s such a classic look and these jars have many uses from drinking out of them, storing liquids, meal prepping salads and more. They are good quality and have a substantial weight. One of my lids did have a little ring on it but it shouldn’t impact function. I’m also glad it’s the one piece lid and not the 2-part lids that some jars have. I am trying to get away from using so much plastic in my kitchen and these jars are a staple that will be used daily.Huh. These claim to be actual Ball jars. My canning jars were all 32oz until yesterday, and I know better than to think I'll get through a canning season without a variety of sizes, so I'm planning ahead. I'm not generally very brand loyal, but it's strange that someone would offer Ball Mason jars without explicitly telling us that's what they are. I'll assume that's what happened, and if they implode when heated, I'll be sure to let you know.Hey y’all, I use mason jars all the time, particularly for storage.
